text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: A few days after Nozomi and {0} started working at Alkes Alchemist Hall, Nozomi was serving her fans with a smile.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノゾミと{0}がアルケス錬金堂で働き始めてから
数日たったある日。
今日もノゾミはファンのお客さんに対し、
笑顔で接客をしていた。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your purchase! Please continue to show your support to Alkes Alchemist Hall♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
お買い上げありがとうございました～！
今後ともアルケス錬金堂をご贔屓に♪

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll surely be back, Nozomin. Next time I want you to make one for me! An alchemy item!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
また来るよノゾミン！
今度は
ノゾミンに作ってもらいたいな。
錬金アイテム！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, maybe if there's an opportunity to do so!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは、
機会があれば！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Lunch break that day.
text_block_list.orig_text: その日のお昼休憩。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...You know, Nozomi-san.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……ノゾミさんはさ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: You can call me Nozomi without the "-san". Rui-chan, you and I are the same age after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノゾミでいいよ？
ルイちゃんと私、
同い年だし！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Nozomi-san. Why did you want to become an idol?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ノゾミさんは。
なんでアイドルになりたいって思ったの？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Because I want to see the smiles of all my fans!
text_block_list.orig_text: ファンのみんなの笑顔が見たいから！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...H-Hm! T-That feels like a lie with how fast you answered me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
そっ、
即答なのがなんか嘘っぽいわ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Really? But it's how I really feel! So Lou-chan, why did you want to become an alchemist?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうかなぁ。
でもほんとの気持ちだよ！
じゃあルイちゃんは、
なんで錬金術師になりたいって思ったの？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Because I want to make people happy with alchemy.
text_block_list.orig_text: 錬金術で人を幸せにしたいから。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Teehee. You answered right away, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
くすっ。
そっちも即答じゃん。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: N-No, that's not it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
違いますけどっ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, aren't you tired of being a crowd-drawing panda by now? ...Not that it's any of my business.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あのさ。
そろそろ
客寄せパンダも飽きてきたんじゃない？
……知らないけど。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: By "crowd-drawing panda" do you mean how I serve customers at the counter? I'm not really getting tired of it, no... Why?
text_block_list.orig_text:
客寄せパンダって
接客のこと？
別に飽きるとかないけど……
なんで？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Why, she asks... You lack perception...! You can probably guess, right...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでって、
察しが悪いわね……！
だいたい分かるでしょ……？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I... I heard you talk over how you wanted to try doing alchemy. I-I won't force you to do it, but... Wait, pugyo?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
れ……
錬金術やってみないって聞いてるのよ。
べ、
別に無理にとは言わないけど……
って、
ぷぎょっ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I want to try it! I'm so happy! I really like you, Lou-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんっ！　
やってみたいっ！
うれしい
ルイちゃん大好きっ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: L-Let go of me! It's too hot! I-I just want to push simple alchemy onto you so I can have an easier time, just so you know!
text_block_list.orig_text:
は、
離しなさいよ暑苦しいっ！
簡単な錬金術程度なら
あなたに押し付けて、
楽してやろーってだけなんだからっ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Th-Then make sure to do this properly! I'll only show you the example once so pay attention!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃ、
じゃあ
ちゃんとやってよね！
お手本なんて、
一回だけしか見せてあげないんだからっ！

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. She'll show her just once she says! You're so kind, Lou-chan! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは。
一回は見せたげるんだ！
ルイちゃん優しいね♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not kind or anything! Wait, the three of you were listening in the whole time?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんなことないし！
ってか
３人、
ずっと聞いてたの！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: We didn't want to disturb you so it just ended like this. Right, {0}-kun?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんか邪魔しちゃ悪いなー
と思って。
ね、{0}君。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Th-There's no way that's true! She's my rival in love! ...It's fine, I'll show you an example of alchemy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな訳ないわ！　
恋のライバルよ！
……
いいから、
錬金術のお手本
見せるわよ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, let's start with the most basic of basics: how to make potions.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……じゃあ
まずは
基本中の基本。
ポーションの作り方よ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: First, dissolve the white aquatic plant and royal syrup in distilled water. Stir for about two minutes at 750℃, making sure not to separate the ingredient... Now here's the magic words! Repeat them and remember them!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは、
白水草とロイヤルシロップを蒸留水に溶け込ませて。
750℃の温度で約二分、
分離しないようにかき混ぜて──
……
よし
ここで魔法の合言葉！　
あなたも復唱して覚えなさい！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Alchemy is... Hee hee...
text_block_list.orig_text:
錬金術は……
ヒッヒ……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Alchemy... Hee hee...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
錬金術は……
ヒッヒ……？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: The more I transmute...
text_block_list.orig_text: 錬れば錬るほど……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: The more I transmute...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 錬れば錬るほど……？

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Sono-chan. Did Lou-chan always chant her magic words like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねーねーソノちゃん。
いっつもルイちゃんあんな呪文唱えてたっけ？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: She's trying to look cool.
text_block_list.orig_text: 映えよ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Sh-Shut up...! This is where the real action begins! Here we go...
text_block_list.orig_text:
う、
うるさいわね……！
ここからが本番！　
いくわよ～……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: "Originaaal Transmutation"!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 『基創錬成』！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Yes, it’s done! A Louise Marie branded potion ready to go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい、
完成！
ルイズマリー印のポーションよ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Wow, that's amazing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあ、
すごい！

text_block_list.name: ルイズマリー
text_block_list.text:
ううっ{0}くんが、
キラキラした瞳で
私のこと見てる……！
これってもう
恋人に向けるまなざしじゃん……！！
text_block_list.orig_text:
ううっ{0}くんが、
キラキラした瞳で
私のこと見てる……！
これってもう
恋人に向けるまなざしじゃん……！！

text_block_list.name: ルイズマリー
text_block_list.text: もっといいとこ見せたい……っ！
text_block_list.orig_text: もっといいとこ見せたい……っ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: H-... Hmph. This is so easy I don't really deserve any praise for it... even though I'll take them. Just for today, I suppose I have no choice but to show you a special alchemy trick.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ……
ふんっ、
こんな簡単なので褒められてもね。
しょうがないから
今日だけ特別に、
とってもすごい錬金術、
披露しちゃおうかしら。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Schari.
text_block_list.orig_text: ……スチャリ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Wow! An alchemy recipe book?! It feels so stylish to see you doing alchemy with a book in your hand! Ah, that's so cool! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
わあっ！　
錬金の調合書かな！？
調合書片手に錬金術って
まさにって感じだね！
あー
かっこいいなぁ♪

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, Sono-chan. Lou-chan's a genius, so she's got all the recipes already memorized in her head, so why did she take out the formula book anyway?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ねーねーソノちゃん。
ルイちゃん天才だから
全部レシピ頭に入ってるのに、
なんで調合書取り出したの？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: She's trying to look cool.
text_block_list.orig_text: 映えよ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...C-Come on, let me show you! This is the essence of being an alchemist!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……さ、
さあ～
見せてあげる！
これが私の、
錬金術師の神髄よっ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: "Ah, hold me tight..." Mitsuko pleads with her moist eyes, as Masao hugs her tightly in his thick arms...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……『「ああ、
強く抱きしめて……」
潤んだ瞳で訴えるミツコの体を、
マサオはその太い腕でひしと抱きしめ』……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Yes, a hug... Hm?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう、
抱きしめ…………
ん？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!?!?!!?!!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: N-NOOOOOOOOO!! T-T-T-T-THIS IS JUST A WEIRD NOVEL I BOUGHT BY MISTAKE!! I WOULD NEVER READ SUCH A SHAMELESS BOOK IN MY LIFE!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ち、
違うのぉぉぉっ！！
ここ、
これ
間違って買っちゃっただけのへんてこな小説で！！
私
こんな破廉恥な本なんて読んだりしないんだから～～っ！！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, I finally witnessed the birth of a dark background history...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あああ、
黒歴史誕生の瞬間を
見てしまった……

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: ...But at times like these, the fact that I know you won't use your alchemy for your selfish desires is one of your good points, Lou-chan. I know how easy it'd be for you to make a potion that removes memories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……でも
こういう時、
自分のために錬金術使わない所が
ルイちゃんのいい所だよね。
記憶を消す薬なんて
簡単に作れるだろうに。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: THAT'S A GIVEN... This is nothing! ...I just... accidentally recited an erotic novel in front of {0}-kun with a smug look on my face...
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり前よ……
この程度のことで！
……
{0}くんの前で間違えて、
どや顔で
官能小説朗読したくらいのことで……

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: BWAAAAAAAA!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ふえぇぇ～～～んっっ！！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Ahem. Time to pull myself together... Okay. Now that there's nothing going on, time for you to make a potion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
コホン。
気を取り直して……
はい。
じゃあなにもなかったところで、
早速ポーション作ってみなさい。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yes, master!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい
師匠っ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Well, first dissolve the white waterweed and royal syrup in distilled water... for two minutes at 750 degrees Celsius. Stir it so it doesn't separate, then say the magic words...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えと、
まずは白水草とロイヤルシロップを
蒸留水に溶け込ませて……
750℃の温度で二分。
分離しないようかき混ぜて、
魔法の言葉。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: "Original Transmutation"!
text_block_list.orig_text: 『基創錬成』！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Bofun!
text_block_list.orig_text: ボフンッ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Eeeehhh?! It's all black and foggy... *cough, cough*...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっ！？
真っ黒に……
ゲホ、
ゲホッ……！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: No, how is this even a failure?! Potions are Create Rank 1! The very basics of the basics of the very basics! It's such simple alchemy that even a three-year-old could make this!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやこれ失敗する！？
ポーションは作成ランク１！　
初歩の初歩の初歩！
３歳児でも作れるお手軽錬金術よ！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: W-Well, what a joke to say that even a three-year-old could make it! Let's do it again, then! Next up is... 'Original Transmutation'!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さ、
３歳児でも作れるなんて冗談きついな～！
じゃもう一回！　
次はちゃんと──
『基創錬成』！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Bofun!
text_block_list.orig_text: ボフンッ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...*cough* Okay, once more! "Original Transmutation"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ゲホッ。
よし、
次こそ！
『基創錬成』！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Bofun!
text_block_list.orig_text: ボフンッ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Bofun!
text_block_list.orig_text: ボフンッ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Bofun!
text_block_list.orig_text: ボフンッ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Ahaha, one more time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あははっ、
もう一回！

text_block_list.name: Alkes Alchemy Hall
text_block_list.text: NO MORE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: もうええわっ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Well, I wasted so many of their materials I better gather them up and then return to the shop with them. {0}-kun! I'm going to take off my mask so stay away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
さて、
素材無駄にしちゃったから集めて返さないと。
{0}くーん。
マスク外すから離れててねーっ！

text_block_list.name: ノゾミ
text_block_list.text:
クン……
よし！　
こっちだ！
text_block_list.orig_text:
クン……
よし！　
こっちだ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yay! I got the white aquatic plant♪ I never thought my smell fetish would be useful for gathering materials♪ Let's keep collecting like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったっ！　
白水草ゲット♪
まさか匂いフェチが素材集めに役立つなんてね♪
この調子で集めちゃおう！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: All right, we've collected a lot♪ As for the rest... I think I'll practice some more here. It'll be fine if there's an explosion here, right? Look, Lou-chan lent me her portable alchemy pot!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
たくさん集められた♪　
残りは……
ここで練習していこうかな。
ここなら爆発しても大丈夫でしょ？
ほらこれ、
ルイちゃんが携帯錬金釜貸してくれたの！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. So with that said, let's get this alchemy practice going! "Original Transmutation"!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ。
という訳で
早速練習開始ー！
『基創錬成』！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Bofun!
text_block_list.orig_text: ボフンッ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ugh... It's no good. No matter how many times I try, I can't succeed. I can't even make something as easy as a Create Rank 1 Potion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう……
ダメだ。
何度やっても成功しないや。
作成ランク１のポーションが作れないなんて……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Even if I continue practicing blindly like this, I can't see any vision of it going well...
text_block_list.orig_text:
このまま闇雲に練習を続けても
上手くいくビジョンが見えないよ……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I guess I really don't have any talent, just like Lou-chan said.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり、ルイちゃんの言う通り
私には才能がないのかな。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Singing and dancing...?
text_block_list.orig_text: 歌とダンス……？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, when I first started aiming to be an idol, I was terrible at singing and dancing. To be fair, even now I'm still learning actually.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば
アイドルを目指しだした頃は、
歌もダンスも全然へたっぴだったっけ。
なんて、
今もまだまだ勉強中だけどね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Back then, just like now, I didn't feel like I was getting better no matter how many times I tried... I was depressed, thinking I'd never be able to become an idol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの頃も今と同じように、
何度やっても上手くなれてる実感がなくて……
アイドルになんてなれっこないって落ちこんでたな。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: But what changed me was... That's right. I realized that I wanted to make my customers smile.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも変われたのは……
そう。
お客さんを笑顔にしたいって気持ちに気付けたこと──

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I see, that's it...! {0}-kun, I...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか、
それだ……！
{0}くん、
私──

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Sorry, we'll continue this talk later! I can smell monsters over there... And also... the smell of blood...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめん、
話は後っ！
あっちから魔物の匂いがする……
それに。
血の匂いも……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Dammit. In a place like this...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぐぅ……
くっそ。
こんなところで……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: {0}-kun, strengthen me! ...Haaaah!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くん、強化をお願い！
……はああーっ！！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: You there! Are you all right!? Are you hurt!? ...You need to be treated right away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そこの方！
大丈夫ですかっ！？
ケガは！？　
すぐ手当しなくちゃ！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah... Thank you for saving me... But... that monster bit my leg. It hurts so much...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ああ……
助けてくれてありがとう……
だが……
あの魔物に足を噛まれたんだ。
ひどく、
痛んで……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: What should I do? Poison is coming out of the wound...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよう、
傷口から毒が……

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: Yeah, so... Even tough you went out of your way to save me, if there’s no antidote, and no healing magic... Unfortunately, it’s too late, I guess...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
だから……
せっかく助けてもらったけど、
解毒薬はないし、
治癒魔法も……
残念ながら、
手遅れ、
かな……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: No way! An antidote... Can't we get it somewhere? Like running to the nearest store, or calling for someone... We have to save this person somehow!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな！　
解毒薬……
どこかで手に入れられない？
一番近いお店まで走るとか、
誰か呼んでくるとか……
どうにかして、この人を助けなくちゃ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah... That's right. I have to make it myself...! I don't know if I can really do it, but...! There's no other choice left for us to take!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん
……そうだよね。
私が作るしか……！　
本当にできるかなんて、
全然分からないけど……
でも……！　
やれるだけはやらなくちゃ！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: As for the antidote page... Okay, it looks like I can easily get the required materials in this forest! But the problem is, the antidote creation rank is... 5. I can't even make a rank 1 potion...
text_block_list.orig_text:
解毒薬のページは……
よし、
素材はこの森で簡単に手に入りそう！
……
でも
問題は、
解毒薬の作成ランクは……
５。
ランク１のポーションも作れない私が……

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: *pant pant*... I'm sorry for worrying you, just hearing your thoughts is enough... Please, don't push yourself...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ、
はあ、
はあ……
すまない、
そう言ってくれるだけで十分だよ……
頼む、
無理はしないでくれ……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Please {0}, will you help me gather the materials? The characteristics are...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
……お願い、
素材を集めるの、
手伝ってくれる？
特徴はね……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Thank you...! Okay, now we have all the ingredients we need.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとう……！
うん、
これで材料は揃ったね。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Phew.
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ふう。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: We have only one serving of materials. If I fail, there'll be no next time. ...But I won't fail.
text_block_list.orig_text:
素材は一個分だけ。
失敗したら次はない。
でも私は、
失敗しない。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...I realized that my former terrible singing and dancing weren't for me, and I made a breakthrough.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──へたっぴだった歌やダンスも、
自分のためじゃないって気が付いて、
突破した。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: My singing and dancing aren't for me. They're for the enjoyment of someone else... my fans.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の歌とダンスは、
私のためのものじゃない。
誰かの──
ファンのみんなを喜ばせるためのものなんだ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Alchemy is the same. It's not for me. I want to help this person.
text_block_list.orig_text:
錬金術も同じだ。
私のためじゃない。
私はこの人を助けたいから。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I WILL NOT FAIL!! ORIGINAL TRANSMUTATION!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は失敗しない！！
『基創錬成』ーーー！！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: ...! I've made it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……っ！
できた……

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: I managed to do some alchemy! My rank 5 antidote is complete!
text_block_list.orig_text:
できたよ錬金術！
ランク５の解毒薬、
完成だ！

text_block_list.name: Male
text_block_list.text: ...The swelling and pain have subsided. Thank you both so much...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……腫れと痛みが治まってきた。
二人とも、
本当にありがとう……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! We did it, {0}-kun! ...And also...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん……！
やったよ、{0}くん！
……
それに。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: We did it, Lou-chan! You were watching over us from the shade of that tree, weren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やったよ、ルイちゃん！
その木の陰で、
見守ってくれてたんでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Eek?! H-How did you even find me out...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひっ！？
な、
なんでバレたの……！？

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. I catched a scent of your smell halfway through that ordeal, Lou-chan♪ Sniff, sniff...♪ You have a good smell♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ。
途中からルイちゃんの匂いがしたから♪
クンクン……♪　
いい匂い♪

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: EEEEKKK!? Indiscriminate smelling!? NO SHAMELESS ACTS, especially towards me!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひいっ！？　
見境なし！？
私に破廉恥禁止よ！！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Hehe, you came because you were worried about me...! I'm so happy! Thank you, Lou-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
私のこと心配で来てくれたんだよね……！
うれしいよ、
ありがとうルイちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: O-Of course that's not it! Why would I even worry about you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな訳ないでしょ？
なんであなたのこと心配なんて……！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Kh! This isn't... I just happened to be in the mood to make one is all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
っ！！
これは別に……
たまたま、
作りたい気分だっただけよ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. I worked so hard to make this antitode... And now it's all useless because of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふん。
せっかく作った解毒薬。
あなたのせいで使い道無くなっちゃったわ。

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: ...The alchemy just now was quite decent. Well, pretty good even. ...Nozomi.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……さっきの錬金術は
ほんのちょっとだけ。
まあまあ良かったわよ。
…………
ノゾミ。

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: You finally called me Nozomi!
text_block_list.orig_text: ノゾミって呼んでくれたっ！

text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text: Like I said, don't hug me! EEEEKKK! AND DON'T SNIFF ME!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから抱きつかないでってば！
ひいっ！　
匂い嗅がないで～！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, Nozomi finally succeeded in alchemy. And little by little, she also built up a relationship of trust with Louise Marie.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして初めて錬金に成功したノゾミ。
そして少しづつ、
ルイズマリーとの信頼も築いていったのだった。
